tasks.title: Build the exact correctness oracle and the i.i.d. null generator for the joint-moment estimator

handoff.objective: Build an EXACT computation of the joint moment mu_m for cases small enough to enumerate, plus an i.i.d.-by-construction null generator, so that any later Monte-Carlo estimator has a ground truth to be checked against and the null object has machinery.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether a later joint-moment estimate can be trusted at all. A buggy high-order-moment estimator fails in the direction that LOOKS LIKE SIGNAL - over-counted coincidences read as positive correlation - so without an oracle, a positive result would be uninterpretable.

inference.fallback_note: Policy aliases do not resolve under this harness; resolved model is the session model, fallback_used true.

named_duties: EXACT, NOT APPROXIMATE. Compute mu_m = E[prod of m distinct failure indicators] EXACTLY by enumeration for parameter sizes where the state space is tractable. Use exact rational or integer arithmetic where possible and say precisely where floating point enters and what its error bound is. This artifact's whole value is that it is not an estimate.

THE ORACLE IS A CORRECTNESS INSTRUMENT, NOT A RESULT. It computes moments for TOY, ENUMERABLE configurations. It says NOTHING about HQC at any parameter set, and oracle_report.md must state that in its own words rather than leaving it to be inferred.

I.I.D. NULL GENERATOR. Implement an ensemble with the SAME n_e, the same block structure and the same marginal failure probability p_i, but independent by construction. Its exact mu_m must equal p_i^m; VERIFY THAT AGAINST YOUR OWN ENUMERATION and report the agreement. If your oracle disagrees with the analytic null, the ORACLE is wrong - this is the test that catches it.

TEST FOR THE FAILURE MODE THAT LOOKS LIKE SIGNAL. Write tests that would catch an estimator over-counting coincidences: known-answer cases with positive dependence, with negative dependence, and the independent case. Report each test's expected and observed value. A test suite that only checks the independent case cannot detect the bug that matters.
DETERMINISM. Every computation is reproducible from a recorded seed and a recorded environment. Record versions and the exact commands in oracle_report.md.

REPORT LIMITS HONESTLY. State the largest configuration your enumeration actually reaches and what the cost scaling is. If the oracle can only reach configurations far smaller than any useful measurement, SAY SO - that is important input to the feasibility question the sibling task is deciding, and concealing it would corrupt that decision.
constraints: runs_authorized is 0 for the CONFIRMATORY measurement. You MAY execute your own exact computations and tests - that is the deliverable - but you may NOT run the HQC decoding measurement being designed by the sibling task.
Write only inside your task directory. Do NOT write into experiments/, ledger/, or knowledge/.
Do not fabricate a test result. Every number in oracle_values.json must be produced by code in oracle.py that a reviewer can re-run.
No security claim about HQC. No statement about whether A17 holds.
Do not depend on the sibling task's protocol: it is running concurrently and its shape is not final. Build the oracle around the mathematical object mu_m, not around a particular sampler.

tasks.title: Red-team the design before it costs compute

handoff.objective: Break this design NOW, while breaking it is cheap. Once BATCH-004 spends its compute, a flaw in the protocol is a wasted batch and a possibly uninterpretable number.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the proposed measurement would actually discriminate the hypothesis it claims to test, or would produce a number that cannot be interpreted either way.

inference.fallback_note: Independent session, NOT an independent model; fallback_used true. State this. Nothing here is admissible toward a rule 13 quorum.

named_duties: WOULD IT ACTUALLY DISCRIMINATE? Trace what happens under BOTH outcomes. If the measurement returns a joint-moment excess, what else could produce that besides A17 failing - estimator bias, sampler defect, finite-sample artifact at high order, a boundary effect of the reduced parameters? If it returns none, does that support A17, or is the test simply underpowered at the chosen sizes? A protocol whose null result is uninterpretable is not a test, and this is the single most valuable thing you can check.

ATTACK THE FEASIBILITY ARITHMETIC. High-order moments of rare events are brutally expensive to estimate. Re-derive the sample-size requirement independently. If the producer's number is optimistic, the whole batch is a plan to spend BATCH-004 on an underpowered run. Conversely, if the producer declared it INFEASIBLE, check that the pessimism is real and not an excuse - and name the cheapest variant that WOULD be feasible.

ATTACK THE SPACE (T) CLAIM. The design must sample true fixed-weight x, y, r1, r2, e. Check the sampler specification for any step that quietly Bernoulli-izes, independently samples coordinates, or otherwise drifts to space (M) - because on (M) the assumption under test is TRUE BY CONSTRUCTION and the measurement is vacuous. This campaign has already had a control applied on the wrong space (DEC-20260802-9664c6 D-5).

ATTACK THE NULL OBJECT. Is it genuinely matched in shape - same n_e, same block structure, same marginal p_i - or is it a weaker object that would fail to catch an estimator artifact? Is the invalidation rule pre-registered and falsifiable, or written so nothing could ever trigger it?

ATTACK THE ORACLE. It is meant to be the ground truth that makes a later estimate interpretable. Does it compute the same object the protocol estimates, or a subtly different one - a different index set, a different conditioning, distinct-vs-repeated indices? An oracle that certifies the wrong quantity is worse than no oracle, because it manufactures confidence.

PREMATURE-CLOSURE, SCOPE AND HEURISTIC CHECK. Confirm no artifact treats A17 as settled in either direction; that every extrapolation to HQC's parameters is a NUMBERED heuristic with a falsification condition rather than an unmarked inference; that nothing exceeds the toy claim tier; and that no discrepancy is flagged without resolution (DEC-20260802-9664c6 D-7). Check the batch opening and both receipts too, not only producer artifacts.

Objections plus the cheapest concrete control that would resolve each, ranked by severity.
An objection you cannot support is WITHDRAWN, not softened. Say plainly where a duty found nothing.
You are attacking the DESIGN, not HQC. Do not produce a security assessment.
